lines.li: [them] I heard you had a fight here.
[us,colony:raid:mechs] Machines, and we're still picking bits of them out of the walls.
[us,colony:raid:insects] Insects, out of the ground, and we're still finding the holes.
[us,colony:raid:animals] Animals, and it was ugly while it lasted.
[us] We did, but we're still standing.
[them,their:tribal] Then the spirits favor you.
[them] Glad to hear it.
[them] Was it {RAIDERS} who came at you?
[us,colony:raid:fallen] It was, and we lost one of ours to them.
[us,!colony:raid:fallen] It was, and we're still here.
[them,colony:raid:theirfoe] They're no friends of ours either.
[them,colony:raid:fallen,!colony:raid:theirfoe] I'm sorry, truly.
[them,!colony:raid:fallen,!colony:raid:theirfoe] They'll think twice next time.
[us,colony:raid:theirfoe] Then we have that in common.
[us,colony:raid:fallen,!colony:raid:theirfoe] Thank you.
[us,!colony:raid:fallen,!colony:raid:theirfoe] Let them try.
[us] Your people came at us not long ago.
[them] I know, and I won't pretend otherwise.
[us] Why, then?
[them,their:tribal] Not every hunter listens to the elders.
[them] Not everyone at home agrees with what was done.
[us,coolyou] That's cold comfort.
[us] Then I'll take you as I find you.
[them] I heard you lost {DEAD}, I'm sorry.
[us,colony:death:battle] Thank you, it was in the fighting.
[us] Thank you, it's still raw.
[them,their:tribal] When I'm home, {DEAD} will be named at our fire.
[them,their:medieval] I'll light a candle for {DEAD} when I'm home.
[them] Word travels, even out here.
[them] I hear there's a new little one here, {BORN}.
[us] There is, and we're all a bit soft about it.
[them,their:tribal] Then the colony's roots grow deeper.
[them,them:parent] Enjoy it, they grow so fast.
[them] Good, a place needs children.
[them] Is it true there was a wedding, {WEDDING}?
[us] It is, and they haven't stopped smiling since.
[them,their:medieval] Then I'll drink their health tonight.
[them,their:tribal] May their fire never go out.
[them] Good, give them my best.
[them] I hear you've taken in someone new, {NEWCOMER}.
[us] We have, and they're settling in.
[them] It's good of you to make room.
[them] You're new here yourself, aren't you?
[us] Is it that obvious?
[them] You still look at the walls like you're counting them.
[us] Maybe I am.
[them] Your council's been busy, I hear, something about {DECREE}.
[us] It has, we'll see how it goes.
[them,their:tribal] Our elders argue for days before they decide anything.
[them,their:medieval] Better your council than a lord who never asks.
[them,their:empire] At home such things come down from above, and nobody argues.
[them] Rules are rules, I suppose.
[them] I hear you chose {SPEAKER} to speak for you.
[us,us:speaker] I'm the one they chose, yes.
[us,!us:speaker] We did, at the vote.
[them,their:empire] At home the Empire appoints, it doesn't ask.
[them,their:tribal] The elders choose among us, but I like your way.
[them] Let's hope it's a good choice.
[them] Who do I talk to, if I want to talk to whoever's in charge?
[us] That'd be {SPEAKER}, our speaker.
[them] And is {SPEAKER} a reasonable sort?
[us,trait:Abrasive] More reasonable than me, if that helps.
[us] Most days.
[them] Who's camped out on your land, then?
[us] {CAMP}, for now.
[them,their:tribal] A good host is remembered on every path.
[them] Generous of you.
[them] I hear you've had a harvest in.
[us] We have, and the stores are glad of it.
[them,town:short:food] Lucky, we could use one like it at home.
[them] Good, a full store sleeps easy.
[us] Our stores are running low, to be honest.
[them,role:trader] I might have something for that, at a price.
[them,town:short:food] We're no better off at home.
[them] Hard times come to everyone.
[us] They do, and they go again.
[them] You eat well here, I can tell.
[us] We've been lucky with the stores.
[them] Luck and hard work, I'd guess.
[them] That meal we had, who does the cooking here?
[us] {COOK}, mostly.
[them] I'll remember the name.
[us] Did {DISASTER} catch you on the road?
[them] All the way here, and it hasn't let up.
[us] Stay until the worst of it passes, then.
[them,role:trader] If my people can spare the time, I will.
[them] If I can, I will.
[them] What's this I hear about {RESEARCH}?
[us] We've only just worked it out.
[them,their:lowtech] You people and your clever ideas.
[them] Good for you, it all adds up.
[them] I hear you're all set on {PROJECT}.
[us] We are, it'll take a while.
[them] The big things always do.
[us] You should stay for {DAY}, it isn't far off.
[them,role:trader] If business keeps me, I might.
[them] I'd like that, if I'm still here.
[them] What's the occasion today?
[us] It's {DAY}.
[them,their:tribal] Then I have walked into a good day.
[them] Then I've come on a good day.
[them] I see {TRADERS} are here too.
[us] They are, you'll have to fight them for our silver.
[them,role:trader] I've beaten better.
[them] I'll leave that to the traders.
[them] Who leads you here?
[us,us:leader] I suppose I do.
[us,!us:leader] {OURLEADER}, when they're not too busy.
[them] Good to know.
[them] You've been here a good while now.
[us] Long enough to call it home.
[them,their:tribal] The land knows your names now.
[them] It shows.
[them] I saw children about, that's a good sign.
[us] It's a lot of noise, is what it is.
[them,them:parent] Wait until they start answering back.
[them] The good kind of noise.
[them] Someone here's expecting, I hear.
[us] Word gets around.
[them,their:tribal] Then the spirits will be watching this place.
[them] Good news travels fastest.
